thread:
Sofia (Vendor Ops): Heads-up — BlockLeaf sent an invoice asking for BTC payout and unclear about W-8/W-9. Invoice attached: https://files.redwood/blockleaf/invoice-apr26.png

Ava (Finance): Crypto payment method doesn't change what tax docs we need. We need to confirm invoice issuing entity. If US -> W-9. If non-US -> W-8BEN-E. Also need to verify VAT ID for reverse-charge. Can you paste the header?

Liam (Tax): Yup. Also ask whether the fee line is 'services' or 'royalties'. Royalties can trigger withholding. For EU vendors with valid VAT and B2B, reverse charge usually applies.

Sofia (Vendor Ops): Invoice header copy:
```
Invoice: BL-2026-0426
Seller: BlockLeaf Ltd
Registered in: United Kingdom
Alternate billing: BlockLeaf Inc (US)
VAT/Tax ID: NL123456789B01
Payment: BTC wallet provided
Notes: "Founder US-based; operations across NL/UK/US"
```

Priya (AP): We can't pay until tax docs received. Put invoice on hold (Hold code: TAX_DOCS_REQUESTED). Request from vendor: 1) Certificate of incorporation for invoicing entity, 2) VAT verification (gov.uk or VIES screenshot), 3) completed W-8BEN-E or W-9 as applicable, 4) statement of services vs royalties, 5) bank/legal payout name for crypto reconciliation. CC ap-docs@redwood when uploading.

Marco (BlockLeaf): Hi all 808080 we're BlockLeaf Ltd (UK). The invoice was generated while we were experimenting with NL nodes so VAT line is a leftover. We will reissue from BlockLeaf Ltd (UK). We don't have W-9 since we invoice from the UK entity. Regarding gross-up: our payments team asked whether Redwood will gross-up for any US withholding if your bank flags founder residency. We're trying to avoid unexpected withholding.

tax-bot: VIES check result: NL123456789B01 -> INVALID (checked 2026-04-25 09:12 UTC).

Liam (Tax): Thanks Marco. If you reissue from the UK company and provide the following: (a) Certificate of Incorporation (UK); (b) UK VAT verification OR confirm no VAT charged; (c) signed W-8BEN-E if non-US payee; then we can clear tax hold. Gross-up: not standard unless you negotiate it. For services billed to Redwood (SaaS/platform access) withholding exposure is low, but we'll review; please add a line on the new invoice describing the nature of the service (e.g., platform subscription, inference usage).

Ava (Finance): Agreed. Action items for vendor: reissue invoice from BlockLeaf Ltd (UK) with correct VAT or blank VAT, attach incorporation docs, provide W-8BEN-E, confirm invoice line description. No payment until docs received.

Priya (AP): Marked as on-hold in accounting with note: "VIES failed; awaiting reissued invoice and tax docs." I'll keep the hold code until files are uploaded to ap-docs.

Marco (BlockLeaf): Understood. We'll reissue now and upload docs. We'll omit gross-up request unless you advise otherwise. Thanks everyone.

Liam (Tax): If anything looks like US-source royalties after we see the invoice language, we'll follow up. Otherwise W-8BEN-E + incorporation + VAT verification should be enough. :thumbsup:

Ava (Finance): Great. Sofia please update thread when you see upload.
